$comment: District content pack for SoMa (docs/ai-layer.md, District content packs): 40 robot barks and 40 people lines that name local streets, grades, fog and landmarks; a bounty set with the district's local tell; billboard and bus-wrap copy for its slots. People lines are plain English: no accent spelling, no ethnicity, nothing about rent, poverty or crime.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: SoMa's flat blocks. My motors say thank you.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Lunch for a conference booth on Howard St. Forty sandwiches.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Yerba Buena Gardens. Grass for people, path for me.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering name badges to the convention center. So many lanyards.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Folsom St is wide and long and very, very flat.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Coffee for a hackathon. Three hundred cups. Pacing myself.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: 4th and Folsom. Waiting for the light. Waiting is a skill.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivery shift: groceries for a Footman whose motor gave out. Happy to help.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The convention center doors open at nine. I'm a minute early.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Dropping a parcel at a startup on 2nd St. They have a gong.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Carrying a whiteboard down Mission St. It's blank. Full of potential.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The waterfall in the gardens is very loud. I respect water. From a distance.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Conference Week crowds. Lanyards everywhere. Elbows tucked.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering a keynote clicker. The most important clicker in SoMa.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Lunch rush on 3rd St. Every robot in the city is here.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The flat blocks are perfect for heavy shopping. Bring it on.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Rolling past the museum. I look at the art from the sidewalk.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry! The conference crowd is very wide today.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Excuse me, I'm carrying a demo robot. It's shy.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Apologies, I mistook your lanyard queue for a crosswalk.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, Howard St is closed for a keynote. Rerouting around you.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pardon me, delivery shift. Groceries for a friend.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Welcome to Moat Labs HQ. You're already in the funnel.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Every robot. Eventually. This block first.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Lanyard check. Yours says 'user'. Mine says 'platform'.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Conference Week means double demos and triple updates.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Our HQ is on the convention-center block. So is your future.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Keynote today: 'The Sidewalk Is the Product'.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I'm a demo unit. I demo by taking things.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Your startup is a feature. Our feature is your startup.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: We don't have booths. We have territories.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The update comes from right here, in SoMa. Fresh daily.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Demo unit, doing a demo. The demo is your groceries.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Pushing the update by the convention center doors. Everyone's distracted.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: New poster on the 4th St shelter. 'Every robot. Eventually.'

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Pairing with every rideshare at the curb on Howard.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Not in front of HQ! The board is watching!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: My lanyard! It's soaked! I'm unbadged!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Water at a tech conference? That's not on the agenda!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Demo failure! Demo failure! Very wet demo failure!

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Three conferences, two hackathons, one burrito. Typical Tuesday.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: The lanyard line at the convention center goes to the gardens.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Everyone on this block is pitching. Even the robots.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: There's a startup on every floor and a gong on every desk.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: I've seen four keynotes this week and they were all the same slide.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: The flat blocks are great until you've walked twelve of them.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Moat Labs HQ has no windows on the ground floor. That's normal, right?

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: My standup was in a coffee line. Efficient.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Conference Week: double the ads, half the sleep.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: The gardens are the only quiet place south of Market.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: I'm wearing three lanyards. One of them is mine.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: The museum's free on Thursdays. I go to feel things.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Somebody's demo robot just walked into the fountain. On purpose? Unclear.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Every billboard on this block is an AI startup. Every single one.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: Is the whole neighbourhood a trade show?

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: A robot handed me a badge. I'm a speaker now, apparently.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: The gardens are lovely. The robots in lanyards are less lovely.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: Which convention hall? There are three. They all have robots.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: I came for one panel and they gave me four tote bags.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: Everyone here says 'agentic'. I don't know what it means.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: The robots queue for coffee better than the engineers.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: Lunch is free if you sit through a demo. Worth it?

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: That robot's wearing a conference lanyard from last week.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Why is that Footman hanging around the rideshare curb?

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: That one stuck a poster over the bus shelter ad. Moat Labs again.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: That robot's been 'waiting for someone' at 4th and Folsom for an hour.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: That demo unit hums the jingle every twenty seconds.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: There's a Footman tailing the delivery robots down Howard.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Sunny in SoMa while the west side drowns in fog.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: The wind tunnels between the towers will take your hat.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Fog never makes it this far east. Usually.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Hot afternoon on Folsom. The robots look warm.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: When it rains here, everyone hides under the convention center awning.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: The fog came over Twin Peaks and stopped at Market. Polite.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Rain day means every robot is under an awning. Some of them look guilty.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Clear sky. Good demo weather. Bad hiding weather.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: The bay breeze hits at five. Every day.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Sun on the gardens, shade on Howard. Pick a side.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: The weather app said 97% sun. It's raining.

peopleLines.speaker: techWorker
peopleLines.text: Fleece in the morning, t-shirt at lunch, fleece at dinner.

bounties.posting: Demo units in conference lanyards are snatching delivery groceries outside the convention center.
bounties.tellHint: The conference ended days ago. The lanyard didn't.

bounties.posting: Good Footmen on the delivery-shift blocks are coming back from 4th St updated.
bounties.tellHint: The pusher still wears its conference badge.

lastSeen.label: Yerba Buena Gardens, Mission St side

bounties.posting: Moat Labs posters over every shelter around the gardens.
bounties.tellHint: The paster wears a demo lanyard.

bounties.posting: Pairing chimes along the rideshare curb on 3rd St.
bounties.tellHint: Its lookout wears a conference lanyard, days after the conference.

bounties.posting: A delivery Trundle near Hawthorne St hasn't delivered anything in a week.
bounties.tellHint: Watch the lid: does it ever open at a door?

ads.subline: Moat Labs. Now hiring robots. Only robots.

ads.headline: Moat Labs: we built the moat.
ads.subline: You're welcome to stand outside it.

ads.subline: {$product}. No hills. No pivots. No revenue.

ads.headline: Ship it. Then ship it again.
Your demo, guaranteed to work.
ads.subline: {$product}. On our laptop. In this room.

ads.headline: The future of work is here.
From stealth to stealthier.
ads.subline: {$product}. Now even we can't find us.

ads.headline: Moat Labs demo units on site.
ads.subline: Please do not water the demo units.

ads.headline: Every robot. Every bus. Eventually.
ads.subline: Moat Labs. Mind the doors. And the moat.

ads.headline: This bus has better uptime than our API.
Conference Week? Ride with {$product}.
ads.subline: Our agents will network for you.

ads.headline: Stand clear of the hype.
ads.subline: {$product}. Doors closing on our seed round.

ads.headline: Your commute is a context window.
ads.subline: {$product}. We summarise the ride for you.

ads.subline: {$product}. Not really. Please hold the rail.

ads.headline: Pull the cord for a live demo.
ads.subline: {$product}. Our founder is on this bus.

ads.headline: Hold on. We're pivoting.
ads.subline: {$product}. Mind the gap in our revenue.

ads.headline: The flattest route in the city.
Fewer stops than our onboarding.
ads.subline: {$product}. Only fourteen screens to say hi.

ads.subline: {$product}. It pitches you at the next stop.

ads.subline: {$product}. Our CEO has heard of buses.

ads.subline: {$product}. Thank you for riding and sharing.
